description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for database connection, SQL query generation using OpenAI, and data retrieval for a student database project.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt string for SQL query generation based on user question and template.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL query, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql ... ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes SQL query against the database and fetches all results.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a message to OpenAI API to generate chat completions based on provided prompt and task.
